title: RdfOntologyClosure
description: A glossary's ontology import closure as reasoning reads it: the ontology graphs of its Approved axioms and terms, the relationship-type graphs they use, and the pinned versions of the ontologies it imports. A version manifest in the RDF store pins each member graph with a digest of its triples; the closure digest identifies the whole closure.

memberCounts.description: Ontology graphs that take part, by the kind of entity that owns them.

exclusionReason.description: Why a projected axiom or term graph is not part of production reasoning: its owner's lifecycle status is not Approved, or it has no status.

exclusion.description: How many graphs of one entity type are left out for one reason.

candidateOutcome.description: What a candidate check did with a requested entity. INCLUDED: its Draft or In Review graph joins the candidate closure. NOT_PROJECTED: the store holds no graph for it, for example a change set operation that was never applied. ALREADY_APPROVED: it is already a member of the Approved closure. NOT_A_CANDIDATE_STATUS: its status is neither Draft nor In Review. OUTSIDE_CLOSURE: it belongs to a glossary the closure does not import.

graph.description: The entity's ontology graph, when the store holds one.

status.description: The lifecycle status the store recorded with the graph.

problemCode.description: MISSING_IMPORT: an imported glossary does not exist or is deleted. IMPORT_CYCLE: the imports form a cycle. INCOMPLETE_PROJECTION: the store holds a different number of Approved axiom or term graphs for a glossary than its metadata, so the projection has not caught up or needs a reindex. PROJECTION_NOT_READY: live projection is degraded, so the store may be missing writes. Any problem prevents activation.

glossary.description: The glossary the problem concerns, when there is one.

importedVersion.description: The pinned version of a directly imported ontology.

ontologyIri.description: The glossary's ontology IRI: its ontologyConfiguration.baseIri, otherwise its entity IRI.

versionIri.description: owl:versionIRI of this closure, derived from the closure digest.

closureDigest.description: Digest of the closure: its ontology, selection, member graph digests and imported closure digests. It changes when, and only when, one of those does.

manifestGraph.description: The named graph that holds, or would hold, this version's manifest in the RDF store.

memberCount.description: Graphs the manifest pins directly: the glossary's own members and the relationship-type graphs they use. Imported closures are pinned by their own manifests.

excluded.description: The glossary's projected axiom and term graphs that take no part, by reason.

candidates.description: For a candidate closure, the requested entities and what happened to each, up to 1000.

candidateCount.description: For a candidate closure, how many requested entities joined it, across the whole import closure.

problems.description: Problems in this closure or any closure it imports.

published.description: Whether the store holds this version's manifest.

active.description: Whether this version is the glossary's active Approved version. Always false for a candidate.

checkRequest.description: For a candidate closure, the consistency CHECK OpenMetadata submits to the store for it.
